standards: RFC 8259 The JSON Data Interchange Format (strict grammar, UTF-8, surrogate pairs)
licence_note: Written from the RFC and from observed behaviour of serde_json 1.0.151 (arbitrary_precision) and serde 1.0.228; no donor code is copied. The JSONTestSuite files are MIT (Copyright 2016 Nicolas Seriot), committed with their LICENSE.
modules: domain/commerce/src/json/ (value, number, parse, write, traits, macros)
domain/json-derive/src/lib.rs (derive macros on the compiler's proc_macro interface alone)

behaviour.grammar: strict RFC 8259: no comments, trailing commas, leading zeros, lone surrogates, control characters in strings, single quotes or bytes outside UTF-8; trailing characters and empty input are errors
behaviour.nesting: at most 127 containers deep; the 128th is a recursion-limit error (the limit serde_json has)
behaviour.numbers: every digit kept as text (a 30-digit integer, 1.10, 2.50); a number is spelled as the document model has always spelled it: exponents as e with an explicit sign (1E5 is 1e+5), the integer -0 as 0, -0.0 and -0e0 keep their sign; as_i64, as_u64, as_f64 and the is_* tests parse the text; as_f64 is None beyond f64
behaviour.floats: f64 values print as the shortest round-trip text, fixed notation for decimal exponents -5 to 15 (always with a fraction), scientific with a signed exponent otherwise; ties between two equally short candidates go to the even digit
behaviour.objects: keys sorted, duplicate keys keep the last value, so serialisation is deterministic (typed values serialise key-sorted, not in declaration order)
behaviour.strings: escapes for quote, backslash and C0 controls only; U+007F and non-ASCII are written as UTF-8
behaviour.pretty: two-space indent, a space after the colon, empty containers as [] and {}
behaviour.typed: ToJson and FromJson with derive macros for named-field structs, unit-only enums and internally tagged enums; attributes default, default = fn, skip_if, deny_unknown_fields, rename_all, rename, tag; Option members may be absent

differences_from_serde_derive: a struct is read from an object only; serde also reads it from a sequence of field values by position
unknown members after the tag of an internally tagged unit variant are refused; serde skips them even with deny_unknown_fields
error texts differ (the native text says integer 5 or floating point 1.5 where serde_json says number; unknown fields are reported before field errors)

enum variants with data need an internal tag; externally tagged, adjacently tagged and untagged representations, flatten, aliases and custom (de)serialisers are not provided because no ECDEV type uses them

corpora.JSONTestSuite: 318 files: 105 accepted, 213 rejected, identical outcome and output
corpora.generated: 20000 documents with random whitespace, escape spellings and number spellings: 19326 accepted, 674 rejected
corpora.mutated: 60000 documents with one to three byte edits: 8490 accepted, 51510 rejected
corpora.floats: 400000 f64 values, and 20 million further random values checked once outside the repository, identical text
corpora.typed: 30000 Outer, 5000 Loose, 5000 Shock, 11 Market documents with up to two mutations: identical outcome and value; stricter than serde on 1180 documents (listed in the fixture)

bugs_found_by_the_differential_and_fixed: number spelling: exponent sign and -0 normalisation
float text: signed exponent and the even-digit tie rule (27 of 400000 values)
internally tagged unit variants and struct-from-sequence recorded as deliberate stricter behaviour

closure: ecdev-core and the three adapters no longer depend on serde or serde_json; apps/server keeps serde_json only at the boundary with axum and rmcp, converting through text, until those are replaced
